on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and

correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

H,W=25,19
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
for c in range(2,10): g[0][c]=8
for c in range(11,19): g[24][c]=8
marks=[(3,9),(11,8),(12,4),(12,7),(14,6),(18,2),(21,5)]
stripe_cols=sorted({11+(c-2) for r,c in marks})
for c in stripe_cols:
    for r in range(H):
        if not (r==24 and 11<=c<=18) and not (r==0 and 2<=c<=9): g[r][c]=7
for r,c in marks:
    for rr in range(1,r): g[rr][c]=7
    g[r][c]=4
print(stripe_cols)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
